summary.text: Jason Tanner is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 20, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Charlice Byrd.
A Marine Corps veteran and former U.S. Secret Service special agent, he works as Director of Forensics at the Social Media Victims Law Center, according to his Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Tanner graduated from Lakeview Fort Oglethorpe High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of South Carolina in 1998.
Ballotpedia says he served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1993 to 2005.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Tanner said he was raised in a working-class household in Fort Oglethorpe, Georgia, enlisted in the Marine Corps after high school and reached the rank of captain during a twelve-year career, including a deployment during the Iraq War.

Tanner said in the survey that he later served as a special agent with the U.S. Secret Service and then built a career of nearly two decades in digital forensics, and that he is now Director of Forensics for the Social Media Victims Law Center.
He said he is running to bring accountability to District 20 in Cherokee County, with a focus on strong schools, responsible tax policy and safe communities.
He named protecting young people from online exploitation and harmful social media practices as a policy priority.
